title: Desktop / Browse
slide_intent: Make a diverse catalogue scannable because users need to compare destinations without reading every detail.
strategic_value: A dark interface with compact purple cues can leave Twitch’s game art prominent while retaining platform identity.
demonstration: A dark Browse screen presents rows of game-cover cards and category labels on a multicolor presentation ground.
practical_value: Compare repeated card proportions and heading hierarchy across a dense catalogue.

content_islands.name: Browse heading and navigation
content_islands.spec: Place the page title and controls above the catalogue in the dark UI.

content_islands.name: Catalogue grid
content_islands.spec: Use repeated cover cards in rows with labels below each image.

content_islands.name: External color field
content_islands.spec: Surround the screen with the case study’s gradient presentation background.

reference_purposes.Application: The source shows a dark desktop browsing catalogue with repeated content cards.
